regime_context: The detector shows a risk-off, defensive lean in Hong Kong: High-Dividend Blue Chips is the only eligible 'trend' theme with strong durability (0.85) and full breadth (1.0), while high-beta China Tech/EV themes are ineligible and deeply negative. The absolute-trend gate is validated here (gate_helps=true) and only 6 of 17 themes are eligible, so the state supports selective, trap-avoidance positioning, not a broad rally call. No scorable ETF proxies exist for the leading themes, so all leans below are conviction-low by construction.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: This is the only eligible theme that is also the headline narrative, with a trend-tag (hurst_tag='trend'), the highest durability_bar among eligible names (0.85), perfect breadth (1.0), and no crowding flag. The validated absolute-trend gate favors staying in this defensive, income-oriented exposure over chasing ineligible high-beta cyclicals.
theses.dissent: High-Dividend Blue Chips ranks only #3 by raw momentum score (0.785), behind two ineligible miners themes; its leadership may simply reflect a defensive bid in a narrow tape rather than any genuine new inflow cycle. No scorable proxy means this lean cannot be graded against a tradable instrument.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips loses its eligibility (absolute-trend gate flips) or breadth drops below 0.8 before the check-by date.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: The scorable proxy (3033.HK) sits at rank 13/17 with score -0.778, ineligible, mean-reverting (hurst_tag='mean-revert'), breadth only 0.211, and a durability_bar of 0.17. The validated drawdown-control gate says to stay out of this theme rather than buy the dip.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tags occasionally precede sharp short-covering rallies in oversold China tech when policy news hits; the detector has no timing edge and rank-IC is near zero, so avoiding is a risk-control stance, not a forecast of continued underperformance.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK re-enters eligibility (absolute-trend gate flips to trend) with durability_bar above 0.5 before the check-by date.

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: Shares the same scorable proxy (3033.HK) as China Tech & Internet and is the single weakest theme in the ranks (score -1.402, rank 16/17) with breadth 0.0, durability_bar 0.14, and ineligible. The absolute-trend gate strongly argues against owning this exposure.
theses.dissent: Platform megacaps can be policy-call options in Hong Kong; if Beijing pivots on tech regulation or AI capex, these names can gap sharply. The detector is coincident and cannot time such events.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK becomes eligible and its durability_bar exceeds 0.5 before the check-by date.
